summary: This Merkle root attests the exact file and requirement-evidence state of the 100% requirements enforcement baseline complete snapshot. One SHA-256 leaf per Step 1 REQ_ID (150 total), each binding tier metadata, gate verdicts, and per-file evidence hashes; pairs hashed with versioned prefixes (REQ_LEAF_V1 for leaves, REQ_NODE_V1 for parents) up to a single root.

tier6_split_mode.rule: Tier 6 NON_BLOCKING_REFERENCE rows are attested through the reference-only policy artifact, not through fake runtime proof. The Merkle leaf for each such row records evidence_mode=REFERENCE_ONLY_POLICY and the SHA-256 of the policy artifact, but does not require replay_refs, otel_span_refs, or negative_control_refs.

caveat: This Merkle root attests the exact file and requirement-evidence state of the 100% requirements enforcement baseline. It does not claim real replay execution, real OTEL emission, full production runtime proof, or full architecture proof.
explicit_caveats: No full pytest run is performed by this attestation.
